name: Nagima Yumemi
source:
Hobbies: Playing social video games
Likes: Works with taboo or problematic relationships (such as love between siblings, a mother and a son, a teacher and a student), Japanese sweets, blonde heroines
Dislikes: Exercising, rules and regulations, reality

[url=/c98086]Toshiki's[/url] cousin who is an up-and-coming illustrator under the penname GoldenLord. She doesn't attend school and is usually holed up in her room, which is a remodeled storehouse. Her older sister [url=/c98133]Chinami[/url] owns a bookstore she inherited from their late grandfather.

She is very sloppy and has no communication skills to speak of. She often takes breaks, can't work at all unless she's motivated and even tends to move deadlines aside.

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
